currentHeading: ## Part VIII: The Year of Initiations
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0087 is the governing item. It requires that the curriculum be completed or reframed as a sketch, and that the missing learning design, facilitation, assessment, and safety apparatus be named. The shipped paragraph doing that is kept and extended.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The full curriculum, learning objectives, facilitation standards, assessment, contraindications, and safety apparatus have not yet been published is absent from the baseline and is retained.

findings.summary: The name lost its meaning and the year lost its shape.

evidence.baseline: the breath-and-spirit human, the pneuma within the human, brought to maturity through the seven initiates and the twelve tenets across fifty-two initiations. One initiation for each week of the year; one year to walk, for the first time, the whole path from Listening to Providence.
evidence.shipped: It sketches fifty-two weekly initiations across the Seven Initiates and Twelve Tenets. The name joins breath, spirit, and the human.

findings.diagnosis: The pneuma within the human is the gloss that makes the coined name readable, and joins breath, spirit, and the human is a list of ingredients rather than a meaning. For the first time is also the phrase that marks the year as a first passage rather than the whole path, which is the modesty CTD-0087 wants and the pass removed while adding a separate disclaimer.

findings.summary: Brought to maturity was removed rather than bounded.

evidence.baseline: brought to maturity through the seven initiates and the twelve tenets

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0087, which rejects the claim that one year produces a whole person.
findings.diagnosis: The correction is right. The re-render renders it brought toward maturity, which keeps the aim and drops the completion claim, and the disclaimer paragraph carries the rest.

debtImpact.note: The unpublished components are named, and a clause is added stating that until they exist this is a sketch of an architecture rather than a course anyone can enrol in.
No enrolment or delivery is claimed.
